title: 日本ダービーの後に・どうしたって

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature manages to beat Tokai Teio in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when she sees Tokai Teio retain a positive outlook for the next race despite losing, Nice Nature is stunned by their difference in outlooks.
